CRYING_SURGING_HEART_POWER.smartDescript: HP cannot fall below [blue]{Threshold}%[/blue]. When [gold]Staggered[/gold], restore [gold]Stagger resistance[/gold] at the start of the next turn and advance to the next phase, change [gold]attack resistances[/gold], and remove all [gold]debuffs[/gold].
CRYING_BLAZING_BLADE_POWER.title: Blazing Blade
CRYING_BLAZING_BLADE_POWER.description: Inflict Burn on hit and on attackers when hit.
CRYING_BLAZING_BLADE_POWER.smartDescript: Inflict [blue]{Burn}[/blue] [gold]Burn[/gold] on hit. When hit, inflict [blue]{Burn}[/blue] [gold]Burn[/gold] on the attacker.
CRYING_HOT_HEART_POWER.title: Fiery Heart
CRYING_HOT_HEART_POWER.description: Take reduced Burn damage and permanently gain Power Up and Endurance each round after spawning.
CRYING_HOT_HEART_POWER.smartDescription: Take half damage from [gold]Burn[/gold]. At the start of each round after spawning, gain [blue]{Strong}[/blue] permanent [gold]Power Up[/gold] and [blue]{Endurance}[/blue] permanent [gold]Endurance[/gold].
CRYING_SWIFT_POWER.title: Fervor
CRYING_SWIFT_POWER.description: This turn, gain temporary Power Up and inflict additional Burn.
CRYING_SWIFT_POWER.smartDescription: This turn, gain [blue]{Strong}[/blue] [gold]Power Up[/gold] for [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turn(s). This turn, inflict [blue]{Burn}[/blue] additional [gold]Burn[/gold].
EILEEN_NUOVO_FABRIC_POWER.title: Nuovo Fabric
EILEEN_NUOVO_FABRIC_POWER.description: Reduces damage and Stagger damage taken, retains Block, and negates the first few hits and their debuffs each round.
EILEEN_NUOVO_FABRIC_POWER.smartDescripti: When hit, [red]damage[/red] and [gold]Stagger damage[/gold] taken are reduced by [blue]{Reduction}[/blue], and its [gold]Block[/gold] does not expire at the end of the turn. The first [blue]{ProtectedHits}[/blue] times it is attacked each turn, it is [gold]immune[/gold] to that [red]Attack damage[/red] and any [gold]debuffs[/gold] applied.
EILEEN_FLESH_REBIRTH_POWER.title: Meat Gear: Rebirth
EILEEN_FLESH_REBIRTH_POWER.description: Fallen followers deal Stagger damage to Eileen. Phase changes replenish followers and restore survivors; an empty field is replenished.
EILEEN_FLESH_REBIRTH_POWER.smartDescript:
On a phase change, summon a [gold]Church of Gears Follower[/gold] for each [gold]Church of Gears Follower[/gold] that died. When a [gold]Church of Gears Follower[/gold] dies, this creature takes [blue]{ChaoDamage}[/blue] Stagger damage. On a phase change, surviving [gold]Church of Gears Followers[/gold] [green]recover all HP and Stagger Resistance[/green].
At the start of each turn, if there are no [gold]Church of Gears Followers[/gold] on the stage and this creature did not become [gold]Staggered[/gold] last turn, summon [blue]{Refill}[/blue] [gold]Church of Gears Followers[/gold].
EILEEN_PRESTIGE_POWER.title: The Followers’ Prestige
EILEEN_PRESTIGE_POWER.description: HP cannot fall below the current phase threshold. Reaching it advances the phase at the start of the next round.
EILEEN_PRESTIGE_POWER.smartDescription: HP cannot fall below [blue]{Threshold}%[/blue]. Upon reaching [blue]{Threshold}%[/blue] HP, advance to the next phase.
GEAR_CHURCH_SMOKE_WREATH_POWER.title: Puffy Brume
GEAR_CHURCH_SMOKE_WREATH_POWER.descripti: Smoke increases damage dealt without increasing damage taken. Gain Smoke at round start and after using moves.
GEAR_CHURCH_SMOKE_WREATH_POWER.smartDesc: [gold]Smoke[/gold] now only [gold]increases damage dealt[/gold] and no longer causes [gold]extra damage taken[/gold]. Gain [blue]{Smoke}[/blue] [gold]Smoke[/gold] at the start of each turn.
GEAR_CHURCH_SOBER_SMOKE_POWER.title: Lucid Smoke
GEAR_CHURCH_SOBER_SMOKE_POWER.descriptio: Consume Smoke per incoming hit to reduce attack damage and Stagger damage taken.
GEAR_CHURCH_SOBER_SMOKE_POWER.smartDescr: While it has [gold]Smoke[/gold], each time it is attacked, [red]Attack[/red] and [gold]Stagger damage[/gold] taken are reduced by [blue]{Reduction}%[/blue] and it consumes [blue]{Cost}[/blue] [gold]Smoke[/gold].
GEAR_CHURCH_SMOKE_POWER.title: Smoke
GEAR_CHURCH_SMOKE_POWER.description: Increases [red]Attack damage[/red] taken and damage and Stagger damage dealt; at high stacks, damage dealt is increased further.
GEAR_CHURCH_SMOKE_POWER.smartDescription: [red]Attack damage[/red] taken +[blue]{Incoming}%[/blue]. [red]Damage[/red] and [gold]Stagger damage[/gold] dealt are increased by [blue]{Outgoing}%[/blue], with an additional +[blue]{Bonus}%[/blue] if stacks are at least [blue]{Threshold}[/blue].
NEXT_TURN_VIGOR_POWER.title: Vigor Next Turn
NEXT_TURN_VIGOR_POWER.description: Gain Vigor at the start of the next round, then remove this effect.
NEXT_TURN_VIGOR_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of the next round, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold], then remove this effect.
ALRIUNE_SUFFOCATING_ATONEMENT_POWER.desc: Attacks must consume a Crown of Atonement to damage this creature. Other sources deal reduced HP damage.
ALRIUNE_SUFFOCATING_ATONEMENT_POWER.smar: Only [red]Attack[/red] cards that consume [gold]Crown of Atonement[/gold] can deal [red]damage[/red] and [gold]Stagger damage[/gold] to [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold]. Damage taken from non-[red]Attack[/red] cards is reduced by [blue]{Reduction}%[/blue].
ALRIUNE_FLOWER_TEARS_POWER.title: Tears of a Flower
ALRIUNE_FLOWER_TEARS_POWER.description: When Staggered, loses HP and randomly distributes Crowns of Atonement among living players.
ALRIUNE_FLOWER_TEARS_POWER.smartDescript: When [gold]Staggered[/gold], loses [red]{HpPercent}%[/red] of its maximum HP and randomly distributes a total of [blue]{Crowns}[/blue] [gold]Crowns of Atonement[/gold] among living players.
ALRIUNE_DUST_TO_DUST_POWER.title: Return… to Dust…
ALRIUNE_DUST_TO_DUST_POWER.description: Remains after death and prepares to revive.
ALRIUNE_DUST_TO_DUST_POWER.smartDescript: Dies when its HP reaches zero or it becomes [gold]Staggered[/gold], and will [green]revive[/green] next turn.
ALRIUNE_CLAY_DOLL_POWER.title: Clay Doll
ALRIUNE_CLAY_DOLL_POWER.description: Immune to Burn and Bleed damage.
ALRIUNE_ATONEMENT_CROWN_POWER.title: Crown of Atonement
ALRIUNE_ATONEMENT_CROWN_POWER.descriptio: Consumed when attacking Alriune; all hits and Replays in the same play share its effect.
ALRIUNE_ATONEMENT_CROWN_POWER.smartDescr: [red]Attack[/red] cards can consume [blue]{Cost}[/blue] [gold]Crown of Atonement[/gold] to deal [red]damage[/red] and [gold]Stagger damage[/gold] to [gold]Alriune[/gold].
RELIGION_FLOOR_IMMORTALITY_POWER.title: Undying
RELIGION_FLOOR_IMMORTALITY_POWER.descrip: Enters a dormant death state near death until awakened.
RELIGION_FLOOR_IMMORTALITY_POWER.smartDe: At [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] HP or less, enters [gold]Dormancy[/gold]. When awakened, [green]restores[/green] all HP and Stagger Resist.
RELIGION_FLOOR_IMMORTALITY_POWER.remoteD: At [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] HP or less, enters [gold]Dormancy[/gold]. When awakened, [green]restores[/green] all HP and Stagger Resist.
RELIGION_FLOOR_FALSE_DEATH_POWER.title: Feign Death
RELIGION_FLOOR_FALSE_DEATH_POWER.descrip: Remains staggered until Paradise Lost awakens it.
RELIGION_FLOOR_FALSE_DEATH_POWER.smartDe: Remains [gold]Staggered[/gold]. When awakened, [green]restores[/green] all HP and [gold]Stagger Resistance[/gold].
RELIGION_FLOOR_FALSE_DEATH_POWER.remoteD: Remains [gold]Staggered[/gold]. When awakened, [green]restores[/green] all HP and [gold]Stagger Resistance[/gold].
RELIGION_FLOOR_RIPE_TIME_POWER.title: The Time Has Come
RELIGION_FLOOR_RIPE_TIME_POWER.descripti: Defeat the apostles enough times to end combat at the end of an enemy turn.
RELIGION_FLOOR_RIPE_TIME_POWER.smartDesc: At the end of each enemy turn, if [blue]{Kills}[/blue] apostles have been defeated in total, living players are left at [blue]{Hp}[/blue] HP and win combat.
RELIGION_FLOOR_RIPE_TIME_POWER.remoteDes: At the end of each enemy turn, if [blue]{Kills}[/blue] apostles have been defeated in total, living players are left at [blue]{Hp}[/blue] HP and win combat.
RELIGION_FLOOR_AWE_POWER.title: Awe
RELIGION_FLOOR_AWE_POWER.description: The first cards played this turn are offered. Damage Paradise Lost to reclaim them; unclaimed cards are exhausted and heal it.
RELIGION_FLOOR_AWE_POWER.smartDescriptio: The first [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cards played this turn are [gold]offered[/gold]. These cards are [gold]Exhausted[/gold] before the end of the next enemy turn, each [green]restoring {Heal}% HP[/green] to Paradise Lost. This turn, for every [blue]{Threshold}%[/blue] HP Paradise Lost loses, [blue]1[/blue] card can be taken back.

RELIGION_FLOOR_CROWN_POWER.title: Crown of Thorns
RELIGION_FLOOR_CROWN_POWER.description: Permanent protection bestowed by One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds.
RELIGION_FLOOR_IMMORTALITY_POWER.phase1: Reduces HP damage from all sources by [blue]{Reduction}%[/blue]. HP cannot fall below [blue]{Minimum}[/blue]. At the end of an enemy turn, if HP is [blue]{Minimum}[/blue], fully restores HP and Stagger Resist and enters phase two.
RELIGION_FLOOR_IMMORTALITY_POWER.phase2: Reduces HP damage from all sources by [blue]{Reduction}%[/blue]. HP cannot fall below [blue]{Half}%[/blue] of maximum HP.
RELIGION_FLOOR_TRIAL_POWER.title: Why Do You Tremble?
RELIGION_FLOOR_TRIAL_POWER.smartDescript: Reach [blue]{Half}%[/blue] HP before the end of [blue]{Turns}[/blue] complete enemy turns to secure salvation from One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds next enemy turn. Otherwise, locks in self-destruction, dealing [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to all players next turn. A locked outcome cannot change.
